text: dsh-web-search-tavily 是 DSH 的 Tavily 网页搜索提供方。它注册 Tavily provider，并将 web profile 的搜索提供方切换为 tavily，让 web_search 请求由 Tavily Search API 处理。插件把查询发送到 Tavily，并将返回结果映射为来源链接、标题和摘要，也可映射回答文本。搜索深度、结果数量、来源片段数和超时均可配置。无需 API key 即可使用 keyless 模式；设置 TAVILY_API_KEY 后改用密钥档位，适合希望为 DSH 更换网页搜索后端的用户。

dsh-web-search-tavily routes DSH web_search through Tavily. It registers as the search provider and maps results to links, titles, snippets, and optional answers. Search depth, result count, chunks, and timeout are configurable. Keyless mode needs no setup; TAVILY_API_KEY enables keyed requests.

dsh-web-search-tavily 的功能「Tavily 网页搜索」：将 DSH web_search 请求发送到 Tavily Search API，并把结果整理为来源链接、标题和摘要。查询可设置搜索深度、结果数量及来源片段数。
dsh-web-search-tavily 的功能「免密钥搜索」：未提供密钥时以 keyless 请求头调用 Tavily；可通过凭据存储或启动环境中的 TAVILY_API_KEY 切换为带密钥请求。
dsh-web-search-tavily 的功能「请求超时与取消」：搜索请求使用配置的超时，并合并调用方的取消信号；超时和取消会转成 web provider 错误返回。
dsh-web-search-tavily 会通过 HTTPS 将查询发送到 api.tavily.com；配置密钥后请求携带该凭据，未配置时使用 keyless 模式。（见 lib/index.js:106-132）
dsh-web-search-tavily README · dsh-web-search-tavily：

dsh-web-search-tavily README · dsh-web-search-tavily：[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

A [Tavily](https://tavily.com)-backed search provider for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web capability seam (`ctx.web`): it makes the built-in `web_search` tool run on Tavily's search API instead of the shipped DeepSeek route.

**DSH compatibility:** validated with `0.2.0-rc.2`.

dsh-web-search-tavily README · Features：- **Keyless mode** - no API key needed at all: the provider sends the official `X-Tavily-Access-Mode: keyless` header when no key is configured. Responses are identical to keyed ones.
- **Keyed upgrade** - set `TAVILY_API_KEY` in `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` or the environment to use the keyed tier (1,000 free credits/month at [app.tavily.com](https://app.tavily.com)). The key is resolved fresh for every search.
- **Official defaults** - `search_depth: basic` (1 credit), `include_answer: false`, `max_results: 5`, `chunks_per_source: 3`, per [Tavily's agent guidance](https://docs.tavily.com/documentation/agents.md).

dsh-web-search-tavily README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-web-search-tavily
```

Then set your API key (optional - keyless mode works without one):

```yaml

dsh-web-search-tavily README · ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml：TAVILY_API_KEY: tvly-...
```

Select the provider (the bundle patch does this automatically; to switch manually):

```yaml

dsh-web-search-tavily README · your profile's cordis.patch.yml：- id: web
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-web'
  config:
    searchProvider: tavily
```
